agricultural-inspectors.zh: 检查农产品和相关作业是否符合健康、质量与安全规定。
agricultural-inspectors.en: Inspect agricultural products and related operations for compliance with health, quality, and safety rules.

atmospheric-and-space-scientists.zh: 开发或使用数学与计算机模型预报天气。
atmospheric-and-space-scientists.en: Develop or use mathematical and computer models to forecast weather.

bioinformatics-scientists.zh: 分析大规模分子数据，为临床或基础研究提供依据。
bioinformatics-scientists.en: Analyze large molecular datasets for clinical or basic research.

biologists.zh: 撰写技术和研究报告，并向相关机构或公众说明结果。
biologists.en: Write technical and research reports and explain the findings to organizations or the public.

bus-and-truck-mechanics-and-diesel-engin.zh: 检查公交车和卡车的制动、转向和车轮轴承是否正常。
bus-and-truck-mechanics-and-diesel-engin.en: Inspect brakes, steering systems, and wheel bearings to make sure they work properly.

cartographers-and-photogrammetrists.zh: 整理航拍照片、测量笔记和原始地图等制图资料。
cartographers-and-photogrammetrists.en: Compile aerial photos, survey notes, and original maps to prepare new maps.

chemical-engineers.zh: 排查化工生产流程中的故障。
chemical-engineers.en: Troubleshoot problems in chemical manufacturing processes.

chemical-technicians.zh: 用化学或物理实验测试协助分析样品的成分或含量。
chemical-technicians.en: Run chemical or physical lab tests to help identify or quantify sample contents.

chemists.zh: 分析化合物的成分、结构或物理化学性质。
chemists.en: Analyze compounds to determine their composition, structure, or physical and chemical properties.

computer-network-support-specialists.zh: 用诊断软件和设备查找网络故障的原因。
computer-network-support-specialists.en: Use diagnostic software and equipment to identify the causes of network problems.

conservation-scientists.zh: 为农场主等土地使用者提供资源保护方案和备选做法。
conservation-scientists.en: Advise land users such as farmers and ranchers on conservation plans and alternatives.

cytogenetic-technologists.zh: 分析样本中的染色体，辅助诊断与治疗遗传性疾病。
cytogenetic-technologists.en: Analyze chromosomes in specimens to support diagnosis and treatment of genetic disorders.

dental-laboratory-technicians.zh: 制作、调整或修复义齿、牙冠和牙桥等牙科装置。
dental-laboratory-technicians.en: Make, adjust, or repair dental appliances such as dentures, crowns, and bridges.

electrical-and-electronic-equipment-asse.zh: 检查线路、组件或电路的运行情况，并记录测试结果。
electrical-and-electronic-equipment-asse.en: Test wiring, assemblies, or circuits for proper operation and record the results.

electrical-and-electronics-installers-an.zh: 检查并测试运输设备的电气系统，定位故障。
electrical-and-electronics-installers-an.en: Inspect and test electrical systems on transportation equipment to diagnose malfunctions.

electrical-and-electronics-repairers-pow.zh: 记录电厂、变电站或继电设备的测试、维修和保养情况。
electrical-and-electronics-repairers-pow.en: Keep records of equipment tests, repairs, and maintenance.

electrical-engineers.zh: 设计、实施或改进工业、商业和家用电气设备及系统。
electrical-engineers.en: Design, implement, or improve electrical equipment and systems for industrial, commercial, or home use.

electromechanical-equipment-assemblers.zh: 测试和调整装配完成的设备，核对规格、公差和客户要求。
electromechanical-equipment-assemblers.en: Test and adjust assembled units to meet specifications, tolerances, and customer requirements.

electronic-equipment-installers-and-repa.zh: 诊断或修复车载音响、导航、通信或安防设备的故障。
electronic-equipment-installers-and-repa.en: Diagnose or repair faults in a vehicle’s audio, navigation, communications, or security equipment.

electronics-engineers-except-computer.zh: 设计用于商业、工业或科研等场景的电子元件与系统。
electronics-engineers-except-computer.en: Design electronic components and systems for uses such as industry, commerce, or research.

endoscopy-technicians.zh: 按设备说明和机构标准清洁、消毒或校准内镜器械。
endoscopy-technicians.en: Clean, disinfect, or calibrate endoscopic instruments to manufacturer and facility standards.

energy-engineers-except-wind-and-solar.zh: 识别并提出节能措施，提高设施运行效率。
energy-engineers-except-wind-and-solar.en: Identify and recommend ways to make operations more energy efficient.

environmental-compliance-inspectors.zh: 调查涉及倾倒、污染或产品法规的投诉和疑似违规。
environmental-compliance-inspectors.en: Investigate complaints and suspected violations involving dumping, pollution, or product regulations.

information-security-engineers.zh: 用监测指标评估信息安全控制措施是否有效。
information-security-engineers.en: Use performance indicators to evaluate how well information security controls work.

manufacturing-engineers.zh: 排查产品设计、材料或制造流程引起的问题。
manufacturing-engineers.en: Troubleshoot product problems involving designs, materials, or manufacturing processes.

marine-engineers-and-naval-architects.zh: 根据规格和试验数据设计船体及上层结构。
marine-engineers-and-naval-architects.en: Design ship hulls and superstructures using specifications and test data.

materials-scientists.zh: 测试材料在拉伸、压缩和剪切下的表现，查明金属失效原因。
materials-scientists.en: Test samples under tension, compression, and shear to determine why metals fail.

mechatronics-engineers.zh: 为工业作业设计自动化工程系统。
mechatronics-engineers.en: Design engineering systems that automate industrial tasks.

medical-and-clinical-laboratory-technolo.zh: 复核实验室检测结果的准确性。
medical-and-clinical-laboratory-technolo.en: Review laboratory findings to verify that test results are accurate.

medical-dosimetrists.zh: 根据放射治疗处方计算每次治疗的辐射剂量。
medical-dosimetrists.en: Calculate the radiation dose for each treatment session from the prescribed treatment plan.

microbiologists.zh: 检测水、食品和环境样本，查找有害微生物。
microbiologists.en: Test water, food, and environmental samples for harmful microorganisms.

microsystems-engineers.zh: 绘制微机电系统元件或封装组件的原理图和布局。
microsystems-engineers.en: Draw schematics and physical layouts for MEMS components or packaged assemblies.

nanotechnology-engineering-technologists.zh: 用显微技术等手段获取纳米尺度的图像或测量数据。
nanotechnology-engineering-technologists.en: Use microscopy and related tools to capture images or measurements at the nanoscale.

operating-engineers-and-other-constructi.zh: 操作推土机、挖沟机等工程机械。
operating-engineers-and-other-constructi.en: Operate construction machinery such as bulldozers and trench excavators.

orthodontists.zh: 检查患者的颌骨发育和牙齿位置，识别异常。
orthodontists.en: Examine jaw development and tooth position to identify abnormalities.

penetration-testers.zh: 编写安全审计报告，说明发现的问题并提出改进建议。
penetration-testers.en: Write security audit reports that explain findings and recommend improvements.

petroleum-engineers.zh: 监测油气生产速率，并规划改善产量的作业。
petroleum-engineers.en: Monitor oil and gas production rates and plan work to improve output.

phlebotomists.zh: 核对检验申请单与样本管是否匹配。
phlebotomists.en: Match laboratory request forms to specimen tubes.

photonics-engineers.zh: 开发或测试光子技术原型及模型。
photonics-engineers.en: Develop or test photonics prototypes and models.

photonics-technicians.zh: 计算或记录光子设备的测试数据。
photonics-technicians.en: Calculate or record photonics test data.

physicists.zh: 分析关于物理现象的实验和观测数据。
physicists.en: Analyze research data used to detect and measure physical phenomena.

precision-agriculture-technicians.zh: 用田间记录设备和地理信息系统采集土壤、产量或地块边界数据。
precision-agriculture-technicians.en: Collect soil, crop yield, or field boundary data with field recorders and GIS.

remote-sensing-scientists-and-technologi.zh: 用统计、图像分析或地理信息工具分析航空和卫星等遥感数据。
remote-sensing-scientists-and-technologi.en: Analyze remote-sensing data from aircraft, satellites, or ground systems using statistical, imaging, or GIS software.

remote-sensing-technicians.zh: 核查遥感图像数据的完整性和准确性。
remote-sensing-technicians.en: Check remote-sensing imagery data for completeness and accuracy.

robotics-engineers.zh: 搭建、配置或测试机器人及其应用。
robotics-engineers.en: Build, configure, or test robots and robotic applications.

robotics-technicians.zh: 维修机器人及外围设备，更换有故障的传感器或控制器等零件。
robotics-technicians.en: Repair robots and peripheral equipment by replacing faulty parts such as sensors or controllers.

security-management-specialists.zh: 评估实体安全威胁的性质及程度，确定问题范围。
security-management-specialists.en: Assess the nature and severity of physical security threats to define the scope of the problem.

solar-energy-systems-engineers.zh: 设计住宅或商业建筑使用的光伏或太阳能热系统。
solar-energy-systems-engineers.en: Design or coordinate the design of photovoltaic or solar thermal systems for buildings.

stationary-engineers-and-boiler-operator.zh: 操作锅炉和泵等辅助设备，维持蒸汽或热力供应。
stationary-engineers-and-boiler-operator.en: Operate boilers and auxiliary equipment such as pumps to maintain steam or heat supply.

surveying-and-mapping-technicians.zh: 把定位数据、现场笔记或测量报告录入地理信息系统，生成地图或图纸。
surveying-and-mapping-technicians.en: Enter positioning data, field notes, or survey reports into GIS to produce maps and drawings.

surveyors.zh: 依据契据和产权文件开展测量，确定土地的法定边界。
surveyors.en: Conduct surveys using deeds and titles to establish legal property boundaries.

telecommunications-engineering-specialis.zh: 记录电信设备的技术规格和操作标准。
telecommunications-engineering-specialis.en: Document technical specifications and operating standards for telecommunications equipment.

traffic-technicians.zh: 评估道路照明、标志和标线的可见性对交通的影响。
traffic-technicians.en: Study how lighting and the visibility of signs and markings affect traffic conditions.

transportation-engineers.zh: 为公路、桥梁、通勤铁路等交通设施编制工程设计方案。
transportation-engineers.en: Prepare engineering plans for transportation facilities such as roads, bridges, and commuter rail.

transportation-planners.zh: 在公共会议上解释交通规划提案，并听取受影响群体的反馈。
transportation-planners.en: Explain transportation proposals at public meetings and gather feedback from affected groups.

validation-engineers.zh: 分析验证测试数据，判断系统或流程是否达标，或定位生产问题的原因。
validation-engineers.en: Analyze validation test data to check whether systems or processes meet criteria or to find the cause of production problems.

veterinary-assistants-and-laboratory-ani.zh: 观察动物术后恢复情况，并把异常变化报告给兽医。
veterinary-assistants-and-laboratory-ani.en: Monitor animals recovering from surgery and alert the veterinarian to unusual changes.

veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.zh: 检测动物血液、尿液或粪便样本，为诊疗提供依据。
veterinary-technologists-and-technicians.en: Run laboratory tests on animal blood, urine, or fecal samples to assist diagnosis and treatment.

water-resource-specialists.zh: 建立或运行水文、水力或水质模型。
water-resource-specialists.en: Perform hydrologic, hydraulic, or water quality modeling.

water-wastewater-engineers.zh: 设计生活或工业给水与污水处理设施。
water-wastewater-engineers.en: Design water or wastewater treatment facilities for domestic or industrial use.

wind-energy-engineers.zh: 绘制或更新风电场布局图和工程示意图。
wind-energy-engineers.en: Create or maintain wind farm layouts and engineering schematics.

wind-turbine-service-technicians.zh: 诊断风力涡轮机发电设备或控制系统的故障。
wind-turbine-service-technicians.en: Diagnose faults in wind turbine generators or control systems.
